method: Manual visual transcription from actual view_image calls on the exact provided files. review-protocol.md was read, then preflight.json; its five usage720 paths were viewed with original detail. reviews/craft-action-first.json was saved and read back before packet.json/full copy was opened; its initial readings are preserved unchanged. After reading the packet, all five images were actually viewed again at native, usage720 and thumbnail320 (15 calls), each with original detail requested and returned. No crop, substitute, altered image, OCR, web, connector, peer file, external directory or agent was used. Observed strings below are manually read pixels with visible line wraps retained; required strings are exact supplied copy. Equality removes whitespace only and retains all other characters, punctuation and case. The pixel form of the time dash is legible but its underlying code point is uncertain. The viewer supplied full images at original detail; no zoom/crop was used, and tiny thumbnail strings not independently recoverable are disclosed rather than inferred. PNG headers were read only to confirm dimensions: X8289 1254×1254, X3584/X6105 1024×1536, X3557/X8148 1122×1402. Ratio errors are respectively 0%, 0%, and 0.035663%, all below 1%; the set has two 2:3, two 4:5 and one 1:1 images. Review uses only the unchanged supplied rubric. Familiar type, color, illustration, gloss and texture are judged for execution; no extra monochrome, handlettering or campaign-uniformity requirement is imposed. Scores are separate integer judgments, with no total or average. Pixels do not certify authorship, actual object mechanics, event capacity, URL function or physical printing performance; no link was visited.

uncertainties: The time-range dash is transcribed as an en dash by visible form; pixels do not establish the underlying Unicode code point.
